item.tib: seng gdong dkar mo gsang ba'i sgrub pa
item.coloph: 'di 'dra man ngag rin chen yang dag bon/ ma sring mkha' 'gro dpa' bo'i gsang nor la/ ma 'ongs bskal pa dus kyi tha ma la/ 'phags btsun kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la/ mkha' 'gro dkar mo mdangs ldan 'od 'phro yi/ (yis/)chu pho stag 768lo brag dkar rtse rdzong na/ rta zla'i tshes bcu nub phyogs u rgyan khrod/ mda' dar dkar po g.yug cing snyan du brgyud/ bdag kyang mkha' 'gro'i gsang rgya thub par byas/ de nas shing 'brug bya zla'i dus bzang che/ slob dpon g.yung drung ye shes gtsor byas nas/ bon gshen grogs mchog rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ phyi rabs don du man ngag yi ger btab/ nyes 'gal ci mchis mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bshags/ log pa'i bdud srin 'dul ba'i bkra shis shog/
